title: Mexican-American War
summary: A war between the United States and Mexico, stemming from the 1845 US annexation of Texas and a dispute over whether Texas ended at the Nueces River or the Rio Grande. US forces won, and Mexico ceded more than 500,000 square miles of territory. The war also reopened the slavery-extension issue.

as_recorded.value: The peace treaty was signed 2 Feb. 1848 at Guadalupe-Hidalgo

importance.justification: Expanded US territory by about one-third and intensified the sectional slavery dispute.
